explanation_ka:
შემოკლებული შედარებითი წინადადებები (Reduced Relative Clauses) წარმოიქმნება, როცა ნათესაობით ნაცვალსახელსა და დამხმარე ზმნას ვშლით. ეს ტექსტს უფრო კომპაქტურსა და აკადემიურს ხდის.

აქტიური შემოკლება (-ing):
Relative pronoun + be/verb → -ing participle
The man who is standing there → The man standing there
Students who study hard → Students studying hard

**მთავარი წესები ზემოთ ნახეთ.**

examples.en: The woman sitting next to me is a famous author.
examples.ka: ჩემს გვერდით მჯდომი ქალი ცნობილი ავტორია.

examples.en: The documents signed by the director are ready.
She was the youngest person to climb Everest.
examples.ka: ის იყო ყველაზე ახალგაზრდა ადამიანი, ვინც ევერესტზე ავიდა.

examples.en: Anyone wanting to participate should register now.
examples.ka: ყველამ, ვისაც მონაწილეობის სურვილი აქვს, ახლავე უნდა დარეგისტრირდეს.

examples.en: The bridge built in 1920 collapsed last year.
My sister, living abroad, couldn't attend the wedding.
examples.ka: ჩემმა დამ, საზღვარგარეთ მცხოვრებმა, ქორწილს ვერ დაესწრო.

examples.en: The issues raised during the meeting were serious.
He was the only candidate to receive full marks.
examples.ka: ის იყო ერთადერთი კანდიდატი, ვინც სრული ქულა მიიღო.

common_mistakes_ka:
**ყველაზე ხშირი შეცდომები:**

❌ The man which helped me was kind.
✅ The man who helped me was kind.
(ადამიანებისთვის "who" გამოიყენეთ, არა "which")

❌ My brother, that lives in London, is a doctor.
✅ My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.
(Non-defining clause-ში "that" არ გამოიყენება)

❌ The book, that I read, was interesting.
✅ The book that I read was interesting.
(Defining clause-ში მძიმეები არ იწერება)

**დაიმახსოვრე:** Non-defining clause — მძიმეებით, "who/which"; Defining clause — მძიმეების გარეშე, "that/who/which"!

exercises.question: რომელია სწორი შემოკლება: 'The car which was parked outside...'?
'The language ___ in Brazil is Portuguese.' — რომელი სწორია?
Reduce: 'The book that was written by Shakespeare'
options: The book to write by Shakespeare

exercises.question: Which is the reduced form of 'The woman who was injured in the accident'?
options: The woman injured in the accident
The woman injuring in the accident
The woman to injure in the accident
The injured woman in the accident
exercises.answer: The woman injured in the accident

exercises.question: The first person ___ the summit was a local guide. (reach)
Transform: 'Anyone who wants to join should apply.'
options: Anyone wanting to join should apply.
Anyone wanted to join should apply.
Anyone to want to join should apply.
Anyone who wanting to join should apply.
exercises.answer: Anyone wanting to join should apply.

exercises.question: The letter ___ yesterday contained bad news. (receive)
The house, ___ roof was damaged, needs repair.
The reason ___ he left early is unknown.
The day ___ we met was special.
This is the place ___ we used to play.
He spoke to the manager, ___ was very helpful.
The book, ___ I bought yesterday, is excellent.
The woman ___ car was stolen called the police.
The building ___ in 1890 is now a museum. (build)
Reduce: 'The people who are waiting outside'
She was the youngest athlete ___ an Olympic record. (break)
